This OpenFlowsheet version can't represent the case, so I built nothing and ran no solve. `list_models` shows only generic units. It has mixers, splitters, feeds and products, heaters, flashes, a pump, a valve, a conversion reactor, a kinetic CSTR, a component separator and a heat exchanger. It has no PrOMMiS property packages.

I didn't substitute anything. For example, I didn't use a generic mixer or reactor for the leaching train, or ideal-gas components for the rare-earth species.

The case needs a multi-tank leaching train, solvent-extraction contactors (rougher and cleaner loading, scrub and strip), solid/liquid separators, an oxalate precipitator and a REE oxalate roaster. None of these exist here. The case also needs the PrOMMiS property packages: sulfuric acid leaching, coal refuse, HCl stripping, organic-phase REE distribution and precipitate solids. These are not available either. The rare-earth species (Ce, Dy, Gd, La, Nd, Pr, Sc, Sm, Y) and the organic-phase components are also missing, so the only component reported here is Ce, as a representative. A substitute built from generic units would not do what the case's units do, so I built nothing."}, "claims": []}
